text:
Matt: Quick update — due to a capacity pressure in us-west-2 we need to shift the release quiet window earlier. New window starts Tue Mar 31 18:00 PT and runs through Thu Apr 2 06:00 PT. Please pause non-urgent canary pushes and any large-model rollouts. @oncall-rotations please confirm handoff and any escalation path. :warning:
Sara: Ack — which services are in scope?
Matt: Mostly inference-serving (eng-runtime), model-puller jobs, and the new batching pipeline. Customer-facing endpoints should be fine but there may be tail latency risk during heavy cutover.
Jen: Are we changing canary fallback thresholds or the rollout cadence?
Srini: Recommend keeping the thresholds but reducing concurrent canaries. I'll set max_canaries=2 for us-west-2 and hold off parallel region-wide canaries.
Srini: ```sh
./opsctl set-config --service=canary --region=us-west-2 --max=2
```
devops-bot: Config update applied by Srini — change-id c7f3a4 (audit log updated).
oncall-rotations: I'm oncall Tue 18:00 PT -> Wed 06:00 PT and can take the primary pager. I'll coordinate with infra to spin up spare capacity if error rates creep. Ping me in this thread if alerts > 0.5% or latency p95 > 1.2s.
Matt: Thanks — also: release-branch freeze for non-security infra PRs is in effect during the quiet window. If you need an exemption DM me and cc @ops-liaison.
Sara: Noted. Any guidance for CS/customer comms?
ops-liaison: CS has been prebriefed; no external comms for now unless we hit a customer-impact incident. We'll prepare a canned PSA if needed.
Jen: One more — the experimental embed-quant rollout scheduled for Thu — should we pause?
Matt: Pause that until we confirm the capacity uplift. Tentative reschedule to next Friday but we'll update this thread.
Sara: :thumbsup:
devops-bot: Reminder scheduled — quiet-window-start at 2639007777, reminder ping 30m before.
Matt: Appreciate the quick responses. I'll post a short post-mortem if we need to escalate. Keep any rollout PRs small and annotated with risk matrix.
